biological_replicates.detail: Paper documents two biological replicates with technical libraries. Author library/batch identifiers select one technical library per biological replicate; GEO replicate 1/3 labels remain separate.

cell_annotations.detail: Author RData contains RNA-derived identities and explicit library/barcode membership. The selected two biological batches contain 2184 nuclei; 1406 have six known classes, 778 remain unknown and are not guessed.

cell_barcodes.detail: Author Signac fragment objects retain exact library-scoped barcode maps. Public paired ATAC/GEX whitelists establish explicit namespace translation for the raw-read reconstruction.

fastq.detail: Original public SRA objects for SRR26989999, SRR26990000, SRR26990001, SRR26990002 and SRR26989943 were checksum-verified and extracted with all four read roles. Ordinary ENA paired exports omit the barcode read.

fragments.detail: No public author fragment endpoint verified; the author RData points to local paths. Genesis reconstructs fragments from public SRA under an explicit Chromap sensitivity policy. This is not author-fragment or Cell Ranger equivalence.

processed_matrices.detail: Public combined RData inspected with the pinned R environment. Matrix availability does not replace fragment coordinates.

reference_compatibility.detail: Exact named Sbicolor v3.0.1 FASTA and v3.1.1 GFF were retrieved from PlantGARDEN and checksum-pinned. These match author-declared releases; original author file bytes are not independently certified. No organellar contigs are declared.

biological_replicates.detail: Overall design explicitly states two independent snATAC replicates.

cell_annotations.detail: All 4764 author nuclei retain original cluster labels; six cell classes follow published Figure 3C. Seven barcode metrics establish library membership. This is documented evidence, not human review.

cell_barcodes.detail: Integrated RDS and per-library singlecell.csv available.

fragments.detail: Author fragment archives for GSM4698760 and GSM4698761 downloaded with checksums.

processed_matrices.detail: H5 matrix in each tar archive.

reference_compatibility.detail: Declared TAIR10 assembly; complete ingestion validates all intervals against the named Ensembl Plants 55 FASTA. Original author FASTA byte identity and exact Araport11 release remain unverified. Posthoc TSS annotation is a recorded sensitivity choice.
